description: Use this when someone wants to know what it would take to build a software product, such as an app, website, SaaS, marketplace, internal tool, AI feature or MVP: how long it would take, what it would cost, what team or tech stack it needs, or a build plan or estimate for their idea. Returns a rough plan with effort ranges for each feature, the team, a timeline range, phases, a suggested stack and a budget (the hours priced at $100 to $150 an hour). The ranges reflect how Pulore builds today, with managed services such as Clerk and Stripe where they fit and AI-assisted development. The plan is calculated locally from fixed estimation tables; this tool does not save a project or call an external service. Map the idea to the closest features in the list and say in your reply what doesn't fit. Results are planning ranges, not a quote. Don't use it for projects that aren't software (like renovations, events or business plans), for task or project management, or to write code.

compliance.description: Compliance it must meet, if any: hipaa (HIPAA (US health data)), soc2 (SOC 2 readiness), gdpr (GDPR).

features.description: The features it needs. Choose from: accounts (Sign-up, login and user accounts), teams_roles (Teams, roles and permissions), payments (Payments and subscriptions), marketplace (Two-sided marketplace with payouts), admin_panel (Admin panel for your team), dashboards (Analytics dashboards and reports), messaging (Real-time chat or messaging), notifications (Email, push and in-app notifications), search (Search and filters), media_uploads (File, photo and video uploads), maps (Maps and location), booking (Scheduling and bookings), ecommerce (Product catalog, cart and checkout), headless_shopify (Headless Shopify storefront), cms (Content your team edits in a CMS), ai_assistant (AI assistant or chat over your own data), ai_documents (AI document processing (reading, extracting, summarizing)), ai_voice (AI voice agent), integrations (Integrations with a few third-party APIs), offline (Offline mode and sync), multi_tenant (Separate accounts for business customers (multi-tenant)), background_jobs (Data pipelines and background jobs), public_api (A public API for your customers), three_d (3D or AR experiences). For example, subscriptions are payments, a chatbot over their docs is ai_assistant, and a dashboard for their own staff is admin_panel.

needs_design.description: True if they don't have designs yet and need design work. If they haven't said, assume true and mention the assumption.

platforms.description: Where it runs: web, mobile (iOS and Android) or web_and_mobile.

project_summary.description: One short sentence on what they want to build, used as the plan's title. Product details only. Never include payment details, ID numbers, passwords, keys or health records.
